tagline: Attach Drive proposals and contracts to HubSpot deals automatically
metaTitle: HubSpot + Google Drive Integration: Folders for Every Deal
metaDescription: Create Drive folders for new HubSpot deals and attach proposals to deal records. GAIA flags contracts ready for review. See the setup steps.
intro:
Sales deals generate significant documentation — proposals, contracts, SOWs, case studies, presentations — that typically lives in Google Drive while the deal itself lives in HubSpot. Without a connection, reps waste time searching for the right version of a proposal, or they share the wrong file because the folder structure does not map to deal records.

GAIA connects the two so the right documents are always attached to the right deal. When a new deal is created, GAIA creates a structured Drive folder for the account. As deal documents are created or updated, GAIA attaches them to the deal record. When a contract is signed and moved to a signed folder, GAIA updates the HubSpot deal and creates the next-stage task automatically.

This integration is essential for sales teams that generate custom proposals, account executives managing complex deal cycles with multiple documents, and revenue operations teams that need document management to be automatic and auditable.

useCases.title: Create Drive folders for new HubSpot deals
useCases.description: When a new deal is created, GAIA creates a structured Google Drive folder for the account with subfolders for proposals, contracts, and supporting materials, and attaches the folder link to the deal record.

useCases.title: Auto-attach proposals to HubSpot deals
useCases.description: When a proposal document is created in a deal's folder, GAIA automatically attaches the file to the linked deal record so the document is accessible from the CRM without manual attachment.

useCases.title: Notify reps when contracts are ready for review
useCases.description: When a contract document is added to a deal's folder, GAIA creates a HubSpot task for the rep to review and send it, ensuring contracts move through the approval process without sitting unnoticed in the folder.

useCases.title: Log document activity on deal timeline
useCases.description: When a proposal or contract is opened by the recipient, GAIA logs a document engagement activity on the deal timeline so the rep knows when the prospect is reviewing materials.

useCases.title: Advance deal stage when contracts are signed
useCases.description: When a signed contract is added to a deal's folder, GAIA advances the deal to Closed Won, records the signed date, and creates the post-sale handoff task, closing the sales cycle automatically.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Google Drive to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your HubSpot portal and Google Drive. Specify the root folder where account deal folders should be created and the pipelines to monitor.

howItWorks.step: Configure folder templates and attachment rules
howItWorks.description: Define the folder structure for new deals and the rules GAIA uses to attach files to deal records, by file name, subfolder, or document type.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps deal documents organized and linked
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both the CRM and the folders for changes, creating folders, attaching documents, and logging activity so your CRM always reflects the current state of your deal documentation.

faqs.question: Can GAIA generate proposals from HubSpot deal data and save them to Drive?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can use a document template and populate it with deal fields — company name, contact, product, pricing — to generate a proposal draft, saving it to the deal's folder automatically.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support multiple document types per deal?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can manage multiple document types — proposals, NDAs, contracts, SOWs — each attached to the appropriate section of the deal and organized in the correct subfolder.

faqs.question: Can GAIA detect when a shared document has been viewed by the prospect?
faqs.answer: GAIA can log when a shared link is accessed if sharing analytics are available for the file. For detailed document engagement tracking, integrating a dedicated proposal tool provides richer data.
